source.stem:
A metal wire is loaded up to the limit of proportionality.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Hooke’s law is not obeyed when the load is increased from zero to this point.
When the load is increased beyond the limit of proportionality, the diameter of the wire will increase.
When the load is removed, the wire returns to its original length.
Up to the limit of proportionality, there is no change in the shape of the wire.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Equally powerful stars appear equally bright from Earth even at different distances.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: An identical star farther from Earth appears larger and brighter than a nearer one.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The Sun appears as a tiny point from Earth, just like every other star.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The Sun is physically larger than every other star.

intelligence.enrichment: The Sun is the star closest to Earth and gives out a huge amount of energy, so it appears much bigger and brighter than other stars, which are much farther away and appear point-like. Closer distance makes the Sun appear large and bright from Earth; much greater distance makes other stars appear as points even when some are larger than the Sun. The learner correctly applies this rule: The Sun is the star closest to Earth and gives out a huge amount of energy, so it appears much bigger and brighter than other stars, which are much farther away and appear point-like. Daytime stars disappear because they stop shining when the Sun rises.
